If you’re already with Westpac, see our special offer for eligible deposits. ### On Demand interest rate On Demand variable rate for all deposits: 0.05%. An On Demand interest rate applies during the 6-business day Variation Period following the maturity of a Term Deposit, if no instructions for renewal or account closure have been received. The rate is applied from maturity up to the day when instructions are received; and after 6 days without instructions the deposit will be renewed for the same term as previously, but at the fixed interest rate in place at the time. ## What is a Term Deposit and how does it work? grey Choice of terms A Term Deposit is a type of savings account where your money is locked safely away for a set period. pictogram accounts-duo Fixed rate of return The interest rate in place when you open the account is fixed for the whole term unless you withdraw funds early. pictogram padlock-locked-duo Option to renew When the term is over you can withdraw your money, or renew some or all of it for another term. pictogram money-in-duo ## How do I manage my Term Deposit? - Manage your Term Deposit in Online Banking or the Westpac App if you’re eligible, without having to visit a branch. - When your investment matures, choose a new term – or move funds to an Australian bank account. To access your funds the same day, transfer them to your eligible Westpac everyday account. - You can set up renewal or withdrawal instructions in advance online, then update them whenever you want to. - Opt-in to get notified via email and your Online Banking Message Centre when your Term Deposit is maturing. - Read more on managing your Term Deposit Frequently asked questions false false style layout-12 If a Special Offer is available at maturity, you must review and confirm your renewal during the **6 business days variation period after maturity to be eligible**, even if instructions were provided before maturity. The Online Bonus Rate, where applicable, is included in the Special Offer shown and is added to your Term Deposit interest rate when you open or renew online during the variation period. It is applied in addition to any other bonus rates you may be eligible for. label What do I need to know about the Special Offers at maturity and Online Bonus Rate? To open or renew a Term Deposit online, you need to be an existing Westpac customer. Become a customer. If you're opening a Term Deposit for a trust, self-managed super fund (SMSF) or joint account, you'll need to visit a branch. label Can I open or manage a Term Deposit online? The online bonus rate as detailed in the Fixed interest rates table, will be: - Added to your Term Deposit rate when you open or renew online during the variation period - Included within the bonus rate displayed when opening or renewing your Term Deposit - Applied on top of any other bonus rates you may be eligible for. label How do I access the online bonus rate and how will it be displayed? Yes, the online bonus will be added to our advertised special offer rates when you apply or renew online. label Does the online bonus rate apply to special offers? No, it is only applied to Term Deposits opened or renewed online. label Can I have the online bonus rate applied in branch or over the phone? Give a minimum of 31 days' notice (except in cases of hardship). No account fees apply, however you may get less than the amount you'd receive if you wait until maturity. label What happens if you withdraw funds before maturity? grey Already with Westpac?
